lookover.note: The composition root: the one place that wires modules together, so it may import any of them.

imports.@lookover/agent-cli: the one `lookover` command hands `wait`, `feedback` and `reply` to its `run` (ADR 0054); the demo world's tests run `lookover wait` against the service on one FakeGitHost (spec #69)
imports.@lookover/diff: the demo driver reads each fixture's diff for the lines the fake host accepts comments on (ADR 0046)
imports.@lookover/testkit: the fakes demo mode runs on, through its ./demo entry (ADR 0039)
imports.@lookover/web: the pages GitHub's redirects reach look like Lookover (ADR 0058): its ./standalone entry gives the design system's stylesheet, the eyes and the theme's key as text, one source, no copy
